title: Investigation into the Quantitative Structure-Biotoxicity Relationship of Antibiotics and their Estrogenic Receptor Disruption Effects.
authors: Zhu, Wanhong; Chen, Shuangkou; Wang, Yu; Xu, Xi; Huang, Xia; Yang, Xin; Ren, Fengming
one_liner_zh: 该文研究抗生素与雌激素受体的定量结构-生物毒性关系及内分泌干扰效应，核心对象为小分子-蛋白互作，而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且方法为QSAR、分子对接与MD，虽含物理模拟但对象与课题无关，仅边缘相关。
abstract: In light of antibiotics being classified as environmental hormone-like compounds, their interference with the endocrine system has significantly impacted human health and ecological environments. This study employed Density Functional Theory (DFT) within Gaussian09, conducting structural optimizations and property calculations on 23 typical antibiotic molecules at the B3LYP/3-21G and B3LYP/6-31G(d) levels to obtain structural parameters and acquired physicochemical property parameters through the RDKit database in ChemDes platform for quantitative processing of the compounds. Multiple linear regression analysis identified the primary factors affecting antibiotics' biological toxicity (pLD50), and a QSAR model was established. The model's predictive capability was analyzed using leave-one-out cross-validation, and the binding modes and mechanisms of action between estrogen receptors (ER) and antibiotics were investigated via molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations. The results indicate that six property parameters significantly influence the biological toxicity of antibiotics, with the established QSAR model C exhibiting regression coefficients R(2) and Q(2) of 0.92474 and 0.74913, respectively, demonstrating good stability and predictive power. Molecular surface electrostatic potential, frontier molecular orbitals, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations revealed that stable hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic interactions primarily mediate the potential estrogenic disrupting effects between antibiotics and estrogen receptors. Predictions from an anticancer compound library identified ten compounds with strong estrogenic disrupting effects, and molecular docking validated the practical utility of model C. This provides a valuable exploration for discovering and screening PPCPs with potential estrogenic disrupting effects.
abstract_zh: 鉴于抗生素被归类为环境激素类化合物，其干扰内分泌系统的作用已对人类健康和生态环境产生显著影响。本研究利用Gaussian09中的密度泛函理论（Density Functional Theory, DFT），在B3LYP/3-21G和B3LYP/6-31G(d)水平下对23种典型抗生素分子进行结构优化和性质计算，以获取结构参数，并通过ChemDes平台中的RDKit数据库获得化合物的理化性质参数，用于定量处理。通过多元线性回归分析，确定了影响抗生素生物毒性（pLD50）的主要因素，并建立了QSAR模型。采用留一法交叉验证分析模型的预测能力，并通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟研究雌激素受体（ER）与抗生素之间的结合模式和作用机制。结果表明，六个性质参数显著影响抗生素的生物毒性，所建立的QSAR模型C的回归系数R(2)和Q(2)分别为0.92474和0.74913，显示出良好的稳定性和预测能力。分子表面静电势、前沿分子轨道、分子对接和分子动力学模拟揭示，抗生素与雌激素受体之间主要通过稳定的氢键和疏水相互作用介导潜在雌激素干扰效应。抗癌化合物库的预测识别出十种具有强雌激素干扰效应的化合物，分子对接验证了模型C的实际应用价值。这为发现和筛选具有潜在雌激素干扰效应的PPCPs提供了有价值的探索。
